saints.name: St. Andrew Corsini
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: A Carmelite friar of Florence who, called from a wayward youth to a life of penance, became a peacemaking bishop of Fiesole…
biography: Born at Florence in 1302 of the noble Corsini family, Andrew turned from a dissolute youth to enter the Carmelite order, giving himself to prayer and austerity. In 1349 he was made bishop of Fiesole, where he governed with humility, cared for the poor, and was often sought as a reconciler among the warring factions of Italy.
He was renowned as a peacemaker and was sent by the pope as legate to compose the strife of Bologna. He died in 1373 and was canonized in 1629 by Pope Urban VIII.
saints.knownFor: Reconciling enemies as the peacemaking bishop of Fiesole.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 4 February
